An <c:ffff00>attack<c> <c:ffff00>sub-skill<c> for <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> with special ammo or
mechanisms that greatly boosts <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> against {{flying}}
foes.
Preparing it drops the <c:ffff00>action<c>'s <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> by 50%.
If, when <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> completes, the <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c>'s <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> is
<c:ffff00>{{flying}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c> +20, <c:ffff00>evasion<c> {{success_rate}} 0%, and
always <c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c>. Otherwise, a normal attack.
